verdict.rationale: The evidence shows Stripe Tax handles zero-tax situations and returns the reason for a tax result in the `taxability_reason` field, which partly covers carrying a reason through calculation. Itemized exports offer line-item tax breakdowns, but nothing says the exemption reason appears in them. Missing for 10: explicit evidence of marking a customer or transaction exempt via the API, exemption reason shown in reports, exemption reason carried into filed returns (TaxJar filing is mentioned only generically), and any exemption-certificate handling.
